physicalNotes: Radius 0.758 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Wang et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2076 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026NatAs..10..818W/abstract): 527,341 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.849 +/- 0.026 solar masses from Wang et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2076 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026NatAs..10..818W/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM.
